title: Browser Privacy Hardening Checklist
metaDescription: Step-by-step browser privacy hardening checklist. Secure Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers with this interactive guide.
intro: Protect your online privacy by hardening your browser settings. This checklist covers the essential steps.

items.why: Third-party cookies track you across websites to build advertising profiles.
items.howTo: Go to browser Settings > Privacy > Cookies and select Block third-party cookies.

items.why: Sends a signal to websites requesting they don't track your browsing activity.
items.howTo: Settings > Privacy > Send Do Not Track request.

items.why: Prevents data accumulation that can be used to identify you across sessions.
items.howTo: Settings > Privacy > Clear browsing data > On exit.

items.task: Disable WebRTC to prevent IP leaks
items.why: WebRTC can reveal your real IP address even when using a VPN.
items.howTo: Install a WebRTC leak prevention extension or disable in about:config.

items.why: Ensures all connections are encrypted, preventing eavesdropping.
items.howTo: Settings > Privacy > HTTPS-Only Mode > Enable for all windows.

items.why: Websites may request access to camera, microphone, and location unnecessarily.
items.howTo: Settings > Permissions > Review each permission type.
